English or português are welcome. Do not include credentials or private endpoints.

### Tool and version / Ferramenta e versão

### What should appear in NOCtv? / O que deveria aparecer no NOCtv?

Describe the metrics, states or inventory that would help your operation.

### Official API or export documentation / Documentação oficial

Link to a read API, Prometheus export or existing LibreNMS/Zabbix integration.

### Existing integration / Integração existente

Can LibreNMS, Zabbix or Prometheus already collect this information? What is missing?

### Testing / Teste

Would you be able to test a connector in your own lab or contribute a small
synthetic API response? Do not attach real inventory or unredacted API exports.
